note: Physical dagger/axe/hammer runtime ABI/EFF integrated into shared Combat Engine; manual Combat Integration Gate regression still pending. Sword ABI301-308 unchanged; magic archetypes deferred.

DAGGER_01.name: Быстрая атака
DAGGER_01.damage: separate 0.20 x average MH; does not replace autoattack

DAGGER_02.name: Отравленные клинки
DAGGER_02.effect: weapon coating; each connected ordinary MH/OH applies POISON +1; independent 5% chance to gain 1 AP per poison application, not per tick; AP cap 8

DAGGER_DEF_03.name: Веер клинков
DAGGER_DEF_03.damage: average MH + average OH per target (OH absent=0)
DAGGER_DEF_03.notes: independent combat checks per surrounding target

DAGGER_DEF_04.name: Смертельная комбинация
DAGGER_DEF_04.damage: one MH plus one OH attack; +10% outgoing damage per target POISON stack, up to 100%
DAGGER_DEF_04.buff: DODGE +5% per target ARMOR_BREACH stack, max +25%, 2 rounds, standard DR
DAGGER_DEF_04.notes: does not consume stacks; missing OH=0

DAGGER_ATTACK_03.name: Сокрушительный выпад
DAGGER_ATTACK_03.pre_attack_effect: target DODGE -50%, ANTI_CRIT -50% for current and following rounds
DAGGER_ATTACK_03.notes: pre-attack applies even if weapon strike misses; missing OH=0

DAGGER_ATTACK_04.name: Шквал клинков
DAGGER_ATTACK_04.damage: N separate attacks, N=target POISON stacks snapshotted before cast, max 10; alternating MH/OH, 60% average damage of corresponding dagger; OH absent=0

DAGGER_PEN_03.name: Глубокий прокол
DAGGER_PEN_03.damage: 50% average MH per existing target ARMOR_BREACH stack, max 250% at 5

DAGGER_PEN_04.name: Абсолютное пробитие
DAGGER_PEN_04.damage: MH+OH; temporary target armour reduction 20% per consumed ARMOR_BREACH stack, max full armour bypass at 5
DAGGER_PEN_04.consume: all ARMOR_BREACH stacks only if at least one blade connects past hit,dodge,autoblock
DAGGER_PEN_04.notes: if all strikes fail keep stacks while AP and cooldown spent; other defenses and checks retained

AXE_01.name: Ярость
AXE_01.self_effect: RAGE +1, max 5, shared 5-round duration, +2% block penetration per stack

AXE_02.name: Рубящий удар
AXE_02.trigger_previous_round: own critical hit OR own successful block penetration
AXE_02.damage: separate 120% MH, cannot be dodged or blocked, hit/miss and armour still checked

AXE_DEF_03.name: Подсекающий удар
AXE_DEF_03.on_hit: target CRIT -25% and ANTI_DODGE -25% for 2 rounds

AXE_DEF_04.name: Стойка возмездия
AXE_DEF_04.self_effect: DODGE +5% per RAGE stack up to +25%, standard dodge DR
AXE_DEF_04.counter: each successful dodge in that round triggers a guaranteed-hit 100% MH counterattack against the attacker, max 5 counters total
AXE_DEF_04.notes: counter bypasses miss/dodge/block but retains armour, critical and resistance

AXE_ATTACK_03.name: Разрушительный удар
AXE_ATTACK_03.pre_attack_effect: target DODGE -25% and ANTI_CRIT -25% for every attack of current round

AXE_ATTACK_04.name: Смертельный удар
AXE_ATTACK_04.cast_condition: target current HP strictly below 20% max and RAGE stacks >=1
AXE_ATTACK_04.damage: 75% MH per snapshotted RAGE stack, max 375%
AXE_ATTACK_04.consume: all RAGE only on successful strike; miss,dodge,block keep RAGE

AXE_SHIELD_03.name: Крушитель
AXE_SHIELD_03.self_effect: CRUSHER for 20 rounds, +20% CRIT, +20% penetration of ALL blocks (not merely shield), +10% incoming damage

AXE_SHIELD_04.name: Удар щитолома
AXE_SHIELD_04.damage: one target 150% MH +20% per RAGE stack (250% max); OR three targets each 50% MH +20% per stack (150% each max)
AXE_SHIELD_04.defense: cannot dodge or block; ordinary hit/miss and armour remain
AXE_SHIELD_04.consume: RAGE on successful connection; at least one hit in 3-target mode

HAMMER_01.name: Тяжёлый удар
HAMMER_01.effect: target tempo -25% (formal tempo control placeholder; no new stun engine yet)

HAMMER_02.name: Отражение
HAMMER_02.effect: reflect 20% incoming damage to attacker in current round
HAMMER_02.passive: each damage event received gives +1 CHARGE (5 separate DoT ticks =5 charges); each connected own ordinary MH gives +5 CHARGE, additional +5 on own MH critical; max CHARGE 100

HAMMER_DEF_03.name: Восстановление
HAMMER_DEF_03.heal: restore n/2 % maximum HP where n is number of charges consumed

HAMMER_DEF_04.name: Разрушающий удар
HAMMER_DEF_04.effect: target chosen body-zone armour -n% for mathematically rounded n/10 rounds (half-up); if rounded rounds=0, no armour debuff; debuff does not stack

HAMMER_ATTACK_03.name: Боевой прилив
HAMMER_ATTACK_03.effect: outgoing damage +n% for 2 rounds; 20% of damage dealt restored as HP, where n=consumed charges

HAMMER_ATTACK_04.name: Сокрушение
HAMMER_ATTACK_04.damage: 3% MH per consumed stack, max 300% at 100 stacks
HAMMER_ATTACK_04.tempo: -2 tempo per charge, max -200; future stun semantics not implemented

ARMOR_BREACH.expiry: all stacks removed together after timer

POISON.timing: tick beginning-of-round stack snapshot BEFORE applying new hits/stacks; final tick on expiry round; new application refreshes all-stacks timer

CHARGE.expiry: only explicit ABI consumption; persists otherwise

effects.NOTES: Physical dagger, axe and hammer EFF are design-only; runtime IDs are not allocated. All ordinary physical block types count for axe shield penetration.

runtime_notes: One active ABI per round, up to four ABIs assigned by MH v1.2 item; OH daggers do not add duplicate ABI slots.
Dagger armour break -3 percentage points per stack after armour rating conversion; dodge/anti-crit debuff is instant before locked attacks.
Axe universal block penetration applies to both manual and automatic blocks; execute/crusher prerequisites checked before AP/CD.
Hammer charge has no ticking timer; all damage events and successful ordinary MH criticals add stacks as approved.
Hammer DEF03 and ATTACK03 fractional charge consumption uses mathematical rounding; DEF04 duration rounds uses mathematical rounding.
Hammer tempo debuffs are metadata-only until the future stun/control contract is approved.
All new combat runners included only in manually-dispatched Combat Integration Gate, NOT automatically executed.
